candidates.D0: refuse future VSC continuation (control; confirms blocker)
candidates.D1: empirical global duration distribution (Kaplan-Meier; remaining via conditional survival)
candidates.D2: conditional model ONLY if N_cal_complete >= 50 AND covariates from predeclared set {elapsed VSC time at T} plus circuit class only if >= 3 circuits have >= 10 complete durations each

censoring.SC_RED_exits: complete for primary endpoint; competing for GREEN-return endpoint

duration_protocol.endpoint_primary: time to VSC-token exit in seconds (any exit cause)
duration_protocol.endpoint_secondary: time to GREEN return (SC/RED exits as competing risks; descriptive only)

hypotheses.A: no duration prediction needed: runtime advances under VSC only while causal state remains VSC
hypotheses.B: simulation beyond factual T needs future VSC duration: explicit duration handling required
hypotheses.C: stochastic duration distribution fitted from history

duration_protocol.mapping_rule: A holds only for anchoring/replay AT factual T; B holds iff MC2 steps beyond T under VSC (verified by reading frozen MC2 engine stepping, no modification); C is the candidate under test
metrics: median absolute error on remaining duration
duration_protocol.question: EQ1/EQ2
duration_protocol.remaining_duration_queries: elapsed marks {30, 60, 120}s post-activation on episodes active at the mark
duration_protocol.success_DUR2_calibration: 80% interval hit rate on validation in [0.6, 1.0]
duration_protocol.success_DUR3_sharpness: median AE on remaining duration <= 90s (one racing lap: larger errors misplace green-return by >= 1 lap at ~25s/lap pace delta)

verdicts.UNDERPOWERED: otherwise (duration feasibility is not refutable from these data; refutation NOT_APPLICABLE)

ending_policy.SAME_DYNAMICS: MAE <= 10.0s (D G1 bar) AND N_ending_driver_laps >= 20; ending laps then join ACTIVE windows for gap/spread construction only
ending_policy.consequence_if_not_same: D behavior retained (ending excluded); no silent merge
ending_policy.quarantine: vsc_ending laps excluded from all ACTIVE windows until EQ5 resolves
ending_policy.test: pooled MAE of frozen R_cal=1.272 on ending-lap driver laps (same driver-PRE base method as D)

evidence_questions.EQ1: Is future VSC duration required by MC2 once simulation advances beyond factual T?
evidence_questions.EQ2: Can remaining VSC duration at T be represented without future leakage and with enough fidelity?
evidence_questions.EQ3: Does legitimate sample construction resolve the gap gate (D thresholds unchanged)?
evidence_questions.EQ4: Does legitimate sample construction resolve the spread gate (D thresholds unchanged)?
evidence_questions.EQ5: Is VSC_ENDING dynamically equivalent to ACTIVE VSC?
evidence_questions.EQ6: Did defensible pit-loss evidence improve over D?
evidence_questions.EQ7: Is pit semantics still a mandatory blocker?

forbidden_inputs: season=2025 rows (outside the frozen D frame)

gap_protocol.REFUTED: episodes >= 5 AND 95% CI lower bound of median > 1.0s
gap_protocol.SUPPORTED: point gate passes AND contributing validation episodes >= 5 AND 95% CI upper bound of median <= 1.0s
gap_protocol.UNDERPOWERED: episodes < 5 OR CI wider (without confident violation)
gap_protocol.construction: D windows + conditional ending-lap inclusion (only if EQ5 == SAME_DYNAMICS); validation split only
gap_protocol.question: EQ3
gap_protocol.uncertainty: episode-cluster bootstrap percentile CI, B=2000, seed=7

minimum_evidence: per-dimension N bars above; effective N = contributing episodes (primary); pairs/laps reported as observations, never as independent N
permitted_datasets: data/v2/processed/driver_lap_state_d9/season=2018..2024 (same corpus as D; season=2025 excluded: outside D frame)

pit_protocol.full_loss_bar: out-lap marginal N >= 15 AND in-lap N >= 30 AND median 95% CI width <= 5s
pit_protocol.question: EQ6/EQ7
pit_protocol.relevance_gate: read frozen MC2 engine for forward pit mechanics; if MC2 simulates pit stops forward from T, pit semantics stay mandatory (no T-knowable pit-free scope exists without predicting pits)
pit_protocol.secondary_scope: all non-truncated intervals (reported separately; exit type does not contaminate the VSC token run itself)

retained_dimensions.pace_G1: re-verify MAE <= 10.0s on validation with frozen R_cal=1.272 (no refit)

spread_protocol.SUPPORTED: point in band AND contributing validation episodes >= 5 AND 95% CI within [0.7, 1.4]
spread_protocol.construction: D episode metric (mean ACTIVE / mean PRE, >=10-row rule) + conditional ending-lap inclusion; validation split only; no calibration mixing
spread_protocol.question: EQ4
spread_protocol.uncertainty: episode-cluster bootstrap percentile CI, B=2000, seed=7

stochastic_policy: 0 MC2 stochastic futures; bootstrap is deterministic given recorded seed
temporal_split: D split retained unchanged: calibration seasons <= 2021, validation seasons >= 2022; all E scoring on validation unless a dimension protocol states otherwise

terminal_criteria.B_VSC_EVIDENCE_STILL_INSUFFICIENT: any mandatory UNDERPOWERED and none REFUTED -> STOP V3.11 coverage expansion
terminal_criteria.C_VSC_EVIDENCE_REFUTED: any mandatory REFUTED -> STOP V3.11 coverage expansion

uncertainty_method: episode-cluster bootstrap (resample episodes), B=2000, seed=7, percentile CI; offline resampling only (not MC2 futures)
window_rules_retained_from_d: entry lap always dropped; exit lap dropped iff direct vsc->all_clear withdrawal (rule v2)
PRE = up to 3 all_clear laps before start_s; POST = up to 3 laps after exit_lap
clean() = finite positive lap_time_s and no pit_in_s/out_s
spread lap needs >= 10 clean same-token rows
SC/red-adjacent runs excluded at episode level
